title: LGD Parliamentary Constituency register
description: Authoritative register of Lok Sabha Parliamentary Constituencies keyed on the LGD numeric pc_id (Ministry of Panchayati Raj). FK to lgd_states.json on lgd_state_id. ECI pc_no is NOT carried here (ECI<->LGD PC join lives elsewhere per the same pattern as ADR-0049 for ACs).

x-changelog.summary: Initial schema. 533 PCs from LGD Constituency Coverage Report snapshot 2026-06-01. Delhi (7 PCs), Lakshadweep (1 PC), Ladakh (1 PC) missing from source report - documented gaps.

lgd_pc_id.description: LGD numeric PC id. Globally unique across India.
